summary: Jeanne Bliss discusses how Zappos ties hiring to the soul of the company and uses a culture-focused onboarding litmus test to reveal true commitment. The onboarding lasts about two months, with periodic intervals offering new hires $2,000 to quit if the role isn’t a fit. The aim is to separate those driven by genuine commitment from those who would take the money and leave. According to Bliss, very few take the offer, implying alignment with a customer-centric mission, which correlates with a high share of repeat business (about 75% of daily orders). This video highlights how culture and clarity of purpose can shape hiring practices and downstream business outcomes.
